generations.prompt: Naturalistic handheld footage looking steeply up from chest height at a woman in her late forties with short dark curly greying hair, a wide lens close to her face, the underside of her jaw and chin nearest the lens. The camera is held in her own two hands just below her chin; her hands and thumbs stay out of frame below the bottom edge for the whole shot, and the frame drifts and corrects a little, the way a hand does. Muted colors, soft contrast, real skin texture, nothing staged. She sits at her desk in an office at midday, in a pale blue collared shirt, under flat overhead light from a ceiling panel, with the cool glow of a computer monitor on one cheek. Her jaw is set and her lips are pressed together the whole time; she does not speak or mouth words. She looks down into the lens and types quickly with her thumbs for two seconds, then her eyes flick away to the monitor at the side and stay there, already back at work, as she puts the camera down: the view swings quickly off her face and across the ceiling tiles. Audio: office air handling, computer keyboards being typed on elsewhere in the room, a chair creak. No speech, no voices. No music. No on-screen text, no captions, no interface, no watermark.
